verdicts.reason: A scrambles the reading order badly: step 02 and the legal line sit at the very top, the product comes next, then the eyebrow and headline, then step 01 below the headline. The step copy is microscopic, the fine print is set larger than the steps, and the logo is stranded at the bottom. B also breaks the sequence (01 above the eyebrow, then 03, then 02 below the bag), its step text is unreadably tiny and the legal copy is bigger than the steps, but its headline and CTA clearly dominate and the logo sits grouped with the legal line, so it is the less broken of the two.
